extracted.name: French Beef Stew
extracted.description: This hearty French beef stew with carrots, potatoes, and tomatoes is flavored with thyme and Dijon mustard for a rich and comforting meal.
instruction_lines: Combine beef and flour in a large resealable plastic bag and toss to coat evenly.
In a 6-quart saucepan, brown beef in hot vegetable oil. Season with salt and pepper, if desired.
Add diced tomatoes, beef broth, carrots, potatoes, and thyme. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 1 hour or until beef is tender. Blend in mustard and serve.
